description_en: Extends the suspension period of an ECS instance that is suspended after a lifecycle hook is triggered in a scaling group. If the default wait time of the suspended ECS instance is insufficient for your custom operations, you can call this operation to extend the suspension period by specifying the lifecycle hook ID, the wait state token of the scaling activity, and the new wait time
description_zh: 如果伸缩组内生命周期挂钩触发后被挂起的ECS实例的等待时间不能满足您的自定义操作，在ECS实例被挂起状态下，调用RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat，通过指定生命周期挂钩的ID、伸缩活动的等待状态标识符、需设置的等待时间等配置参数，延长挂起时间
kebab_example: aliyun ess record-lifecycle-action-heartbeat --lifecycle-hook-id ash-bp1fxuqyi98w0aib0000 --lifecycle-action-token F324B880-900E-4968-85DD-816911130000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lifecycle hook
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_id

parameters.help_en:
The wait state token of the scaling activity. When the instance is suspended, you can obtain this token from the details page of the message received from the MNS queue specified by the lifecycle hook.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459333.html operation to obtain this token.

Alternatively, you can obtain this value from the MNS topic specified by the lifecycle hook
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动的等待状态标识符，您可以在实例被挂起的状态下，从生命周期挂钩指定的MNS队列中，接收消息对应的详情页中获取。

也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459333.html获取。

还可以从生命周期挂钩指定的MNS主题中获取该值
parameters.name: lifecycle_action_token

parameters.help_en:
The wait time configured in the lifecycle hook for the scaling activity. If the wait state times out, the default execution policy is executed. Valid values: 30 to 21600. Unit: seconds.

After you create a lifecycle hook, you can call this operation to extend the wait time of the ECS instance, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459335.html operation to end the wait state of the scaling activity in advance.

Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩为伸缩组活动设置的等待时间，等待状态超时后会执行默认执行策略。取值范围：30~21600，单位：秒。

创建了生命周期挂钩后，您可以调用本接口延长ECS实例的等待时间，也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459335.html提前结束伸缩活动的等待状态。

默认值：600
parameters.name: heartbeat_timeout

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id
